contract: ValinityGovernanceCommittee (VGC) — governance + keeper-funding token (the VGO's minted reward token)
deployment: NON-PROXY, NON-UPGRADEABLE (plain ERC20 + ERC20Permit, constructor-based; EIP-1967 impl slot EMPTY). Logic permanently FROZEN. numDeployments=1.

whatItIs: Plain ERC20 + ERC20Permit (EIP-2612), 18 decimals, NO transfer fee / NO burn (burn omitted deliberately — would let supply shrink to cheapen governance bps-of-supply thresholds). Dual role: governance token + keeper-funding token (the VGO is its sole minter, rewarding keepers). Credibly-fixed monetary policy (all schedule numbers are constants; changing them = redeploy).

monetaryPolicy.INITIAL_SUPPLY: 1,000,000e18 minted to `treasury` at construction (seeds the VARO launch)
monetaryPolicy.MAX_EPOCH_MINT_BPS: 25 (0.25%/week of the unminted supply) — IMMUTABLE cap on the ceiling -> emission can only be slowed/halted, never accelerated past the ~8-year-to-70% schedule
monetaryPolicy.epochMintBps: admin-settable, <= MAX_EPOCH_MINT_BPS, 0 = halt (kill switch); starts at 25
monetaryPolicy.ceiling: each epoch the minter may mint at most epochMintBps of (MAX_SUPPLY - totalSupply()) snapshotted at the epoch start (geometric on unminted supply); both unminted AND bps frozen at epoch start (mid-epoch setEpochMintBps only takes effect next epoch)

trustModel: Sole `minter` (the VGO), set ONCE via setMinter -> minterLocked forever (irreversible). `admin` (two-step transfer -> governance Executor) sets the minter once + tunes/halts the ceiling. Admin CANNOT mint, change the minter after lock, or move balances. No admin mint, no burn, no balance-move, no upgrade.

liveConfig.totalSupply: 1,000,000 VGC (only the INITIAL_SUPPLY seed — no epoch minting has occurred)
liveConfig.epoch: {start:0, bps:0, minted:0, unminted:0} (never minted via the epoch path)
liveConfig.initialSupplyHolder: 0x8310eA7E (the constructor `treasury` arg = the KMS itself holds the 1,000,000 VGC seed)
liveConfig.dormancy: DOUBLY-DORMANT keeper-reward path: VGC.minter=0 (no epoch emission possible) AND VGO.vgc=0 (VGO not wired). Activation = VGC.setMinter(VGO) [one-time lock] + VGO.wireVgc(VGC).

audit.workflow: w5mu2e3r7 (73 agents, 4 survived / 61 refuted) — 7 dimensions. NO Critical/High/Medium code findings.
audit.verdict: Emission provably bounded — sound cap + kill-switch. Per-epoch ceiling <= epochMintBps (<=0.25%/wk) of unminted supply (frozen at epoch start); totalSupply STRICTLY < MAX_SUPPLY forever (induction: bps<10000 => each epoch adds < remaining; MAX_SUPPLY-totalSupply never underflows); skipping epochs does NOT compound; uint96 packing safe (cap<=1.75e22, supply<=7e24 << uint96 max); getMintAllowance() EXACTLY mirrors mint(); epochMintBps=0 halts; mid-epoch setEpochMintBps only effective next epoch (admin can't accelerate). Stock OZ ERC20+Permit: no fee/burn/hook (mint to can't reenter)/pausable/blacklist/rebase; EIP-2612 OZ-default. Sole minter one-time-locked; admin can ONLY slow/halt (never mint/move/accelerate/upgrade). NON-PROXY immutable.
audit.findings: All Low/operational (immutable contract, minter UNSET/dormant live): L1 activation-window admin risk (while minter unset, compromised admin could setMinter(malicious) -> bounded ~17.5k VGC/wk, irreversible once locked; extinguished by setMinter(audited VGO)). L2 admin halt epochMintBps=0 (intended kill-switch; ~7-day latency since the active ceiling reads the frozen e.bps). L3 transferAdmin lacks zero-address check (reversible ops nit; acceptAdmin rejects zero). L4 1M INITIAL_SUPPLY at KMS EOA = 100% of current supply / ~14% of MAX (governance-centralization at handoff; VGC is also the vote token).
audit.handoff: (1) one-time setMinter(VGO 0x0a6C2117) from a trusted admin -> point at the AUDITED VGO; pair with VGO.wireVgc(VGC); irreversible. (2) keep epochMintBps sane (<=25; 0=halt). (3) migrate admin -> governance Executor (two-step; low blast radius). (4) decide the 1M seed disposition. No upgrade lever (immutable).

validatesVgoDependency: This audit confirms VGO-M2: VGC DOES correctly implement the per-epoch emission ceiling + sole-minter lock + 0=halt kill-switch that the VGO keeper-reward audit depends on.
